|value = 250 |gprice = Not Sold }} The '''Immunity Band''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be dropped as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] in [[the Mines]] on floors 100+, the [[Quarry Mine]], and the [[Skull Cavern]]. The Immunity Band increases [[Immunity]] by 4. Equipping a second Immunity Band adds a further 4 Immunity. ==Dyeing== Immunity Band can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==References== Ring::AddEquipmentEffects is called once for each ring by BuffManager::GetValues. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Immunitätsband]] [[es:Banda de inmunidad]] [[fr:Anneau d'immunité]] [[it:Fascia dell'immunità]] [[ja:イミュニティバンド]] [[ko:면역의 띠]] [[hu:Immunitás szalag]] [[pt:Anel de Imunidade]] [[ru:Перстень преодоления]] [[tr:Dokunulmazlık Yüzüğü]] [[zh:免疫指环]]
